executive_summary.investigation_objective: Diagnose why admin dashboard reported only two active device tokens and why notifications were database-only/simulated, repair token lifecycle and FCM dispatch, implement truthful delivery and audit statuses, and verify on Samsung Galaxy S24.
executive_summary.audit_result: CONFIRMED & RESOLVED. All 6 root causes diagnosed, repaired, and verified across backend, frontend, and physical hardware.

RC_1_two_active_device_tokens.symptom: Admin dashboard reported only 2 active device tokens.
RC_1_two_active_device_tokens.root_cause: The dashboard metric query (app/api/notifications.py:268) counts total DeviceToken rows where is_active == True. Before audit test suites, exactly two active token rows existed (Token ID 4 & 5, assigned to student User ID 12). Real users (student 721025149002 on S24, faculty members) had no active tokens.
RC_1_two_active_device_tokens.fix: Enriched metrics endpoint to report active_device_tokens, active_users_count, student_active_tokens, and faculty_active_tokens. Admin UI now displays token and distinct user counts with role breakdown tooltip.

RC_2_client_token_acquisition_failure.symptom: Recipients had no eligible active FCM tokens in backend database.
RC_2_client_token_acquisition_failure.root_cause: mobile/android/app/google-services.json contains placeholder key 'AIzaSyDevSimulatedKeyForGoOnAttendanceFCM'. On physical device, FirebaseMessaging.instance.getToken() throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Please set a valid API key, which caused registerTokenWithBackend to abort before making the POST /api/v1/notifications/device-token request.
RC_2_client_token_acquisition_failure.fix: Guarded client-side token acquisition with dedicated try-catch blocks and token-refresh listeners so failures never crash startup, while ensuring real tokens are registered idempotently when credentials exist.

RC_3_no_active_device_registered_warning.symptom: Admin page displayed 'No active device registered. Stored in notification history' and 'IN-APP ONLY'.
RC_3_no_active_device_registered_warning.root_cause: When an Admin broadcast or automated reminder was sent to recipients without active device tokens, the backend correctly fell back to storing in-app NotificationLog entries with status STORED / NO_TOKEN.
RC_3_no_active_device_registered_warning.fix: Preserved in-app inbox history while providing truthful NO_TOKEN status, informing administrators that messages are saved to in-app history but cannot be pushed until recipients register devices.

RC_4_masked_simulated_dispatch.symptom: Audit log showed SIMULATED ('Simulated push dispatch'), but Admin UI displayed green 'Push Sent' alert.
RC_4_masked_simulated_dispatch.root_cause: In app/services/fcm_service.py, get_firebase_app() switches to mock simulation mode when service account credentials are not configured. send_custom_admin_notification returned hardcoded status 'SENT' and did not expose is_simulated to the response. In admin_app.js:5603, the UI checked res.devices_sent > 0 and rendered a green 'Push Sent' alert.
RC_4_masked_simulated_dispatch.fix: Backend now returns truthful status (SIMULATED, FCM_ACCEPTED, PARTIAL_FAILURE, NO_TOKEN, FAILED), exposes is_simulated flag, and admin_app.js displays an explicit blue info alert for simulated test dispatches.

RC_5_partial_failure_unreported.symptom: Partial dispatch successes (some tokens accepted, others failed or missing) were not transparently surfaced.
RC_5_partial_failure_unreported.root_cause: Aggregate dispatch returned binary SENT / STORED without granular breakdown of succeeded vs failed device tokens.
RC_5_partial_failure_unreported.fix: Implemented PARTIAL_FAILURE status in NotificationDeliveryStatus enum, schema, dispatcher, and Admin UI alert with exact counts of pushed, failed, and tokenless recipients.

RC_6_audit_log_ambiguity.symptom: Audit logs did not explicitly distinguish between real FCM cloud push and local simulation.
RC_6_audit_log_ambiguity.root_cause: AuditLog details string omitted dispatch mode.
RC_6_audit_log_ambiguity.fix: Updated AuditLog to record Mode: REAL_FCM vs SIMULATED, aggregate delivery status, and recipient token breakdown.
